---
title: "panel-live Quarto Test"
---

This site tests the `panel-live` Quarto extension.

## Default Mode (Editor)

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: editor
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Value", start=0, end=10, value=5)
pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"## {v}", slider)).servable()
```

## App Mode

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: app
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Value", start=0, end=10, value=5)
pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"## {v}", slider)).servable()
```

## App Mode With Requirements

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: app
#| requirements: numpy
import panel as pn
```
